component.name: AFFiNITe
component.summary: Local-first workspace for docs, whiteboards, Kanban boards, LaTeX, and AI

description.p: AFFiNITe is a privacy-focused, local-first personal knowledge management and productivity workspace designed for Linux and cross-platform environments. It combines documents, edgeless whiteboards, databases, Kanban boards, calendar planning, LaTeX scientific writing, Mermaid diagramming, and local AI into a unified offline-first application.

ul.li: Rich block-based documents and infinite Edgeless whiteboards powered by BlockSuite and Yjs CRDTs
Mermaid Pro Suite with live split-view editor, dark mode theming, templates, and SVG export
Daily and ISO Weekly Notes integrated with a native Monthly and Weekly Calendar planner
Native Kanban Project Boards with due date synchronization and progress tracking
Scientific LaTeX editor with live KaTeX preview, BibTeX management, and PDF compilation
Zero-API-key AI integration supporting Google Antigravity CLI (agy), local CLI models, and Ollama

description.p: Release v0.29.0: Native Flatpak bundle, offline SQLite blob mirror, single-renderer lightweight tabs, Linux Wayland GPU acceleration and Hyprland blank screen fix, Mermaid Pro Suite, ISO Weekly Notes, Weekly Reports Hub, supercharged Calendar Planner, Habits tracking suite with date sync, and zero-API-key Google Antigravity and Ollama AI integration.

Added Mermaid Pro Suite with live split editor and templates, ISO Weekly Notes, native Monthly and Weekly Calendar planner synced with Kanban Boards, and zero-API-key Antigravity CLI and Ollama AI integration.
